newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Allianz to increase stake in MMI.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Allianz to increase stake in MMI.

text.p: MMI Ltd said on Thursday that German insurer Allianz AG would increase its stake in the Australian insurance group to 38 percent from 18 percent.

MMI said the higher shareholding would be achieved with the purchase of the 20 percent stake now held by Australian Business Ltd, formerly the Chamber of Manufactures of New South Wales, for A$4.00 per share.
It also said MMI would acquire 20 percent of Allianz Insurance (Singapore) Pte Ltd for A$23.9 million.

MMI said independent directors believed the transactions would strengthen MMI's competitive position in the Australian and Asian markets. It said a meeting of shareholders was proposed for December 20 to vote on the resolutions.
MMI said the proposed acquisition of an interest in Allianz Singapore was an important strategic development.

It would provide MMI with immediate access to the Singapore insurance market and the reinsurance business of Allianz in the entire Asian region, as Singapore was the regional headquarters for Allianz's Asian operations.
MMI said it had also entered into a business expansion agreement with Allianz.
This gave MMI the opportunity to acquire equity interests in Allianz's existing and future Asian operations, and active support from Allianz for MMI to develop its own inwards reinsurance business.
Allianz would also help MMI secure global business, while MMI would have access to Allianz technology.
MMI said Australian Business Ltd's stake in MMI would be reduced to about 21 percent. Australian Business Ltd had said it intended to retain the holding for at least two years, it said.
